plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Knudson (April 1971, PNAS 68: 820–823) semi-logarithmic retinoblastoma survival curve plots 48 bilateral (hereditary, one-hit linear exponential log S = -kt, mean 3 tumours) vs unilateral (non-hereditary, two-hit quadratic curve, 1 tumour) cases, proving recessive two-hit inactivation of both maternal and paternal RB1 alleles.

teach_overlay.label: APR 1971 KNUDSON TWO-HIT CURVE (48 CASES, PNAS): HEREDITARY 1-HIT LINE VS SPORADIC 2-HIT CURVE (2 RB1 BRAKE CABLES PER CELL)
teach_overlay.detail: Inked Knudson (April 1971, PNAS 68: 820–823) semi-logarithmic retinoblastoma survival curve on period paper plotting 48 bilateral (hereditary, one-hit linear exponential log S = -kt, mean 3 tumors) vs unilateral (non-hereditary, two-hit quadratic curve, 1 tumor) cases, proving recessive two-hit inactivation of both maternal and paternal RB1 alleles
teach_overlay.scale: having two copies of every tumour-suppressor gene is like flying on an airliner with twin backup hydraulic brakes — if random chance cuts one cable in a million cells, the backup cable still stops the plane, unless lightning strikes the exact same cell twice
